final: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_avg FROM phase_stats), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_bandusage, p.station_count, p.avg_bandusage - m.mean_avg AS excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage), SUM(station_count), AVG(excess) FROM kept
